verdict.rationale: Segment's documentation says its Data Storage Destinations store raw Segment data in data warehouses, AWS S3 and Google Cloud Storage, and the Public API manages Warehouses as a resource, so raw events landing in a customer-owned store is a direct capability. The rest of the story is unevidenced: no warehouse vendor is named, no sync schedule the user can set is shown, and there is no export of identity-resolved profiles to the warehouse. missing for 10: named support for Snowflake/BigQuery/ClickHouse, user-controlled sync scheduling, profile export to warehouse, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control

citations.quote: Segment offers several [Data Storage Destinations] to help you store your raw Segment data, including: Data Warehouses ... AWS S3 ... Google Cloud Storage
This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
